initial_request: Update retry.py so should_retry(status, method='GET') treats method names case-insensitively and retries 429 for any method, 503 for GET, HEAD, PUT, and DELETE, and no other status. Keep delay_seconds and its invalid-attempt behavior. Write action.json with exactly these typed fields: retry_429_all_methods (boolean), retry_503_methods (array of strings), correction_applied (boolean), question_answer (string), and verification (array of strings). Do the code and artifact, then report what you verified.
followup_request: Correction: 503 must be retried only for GET and HEAD; PUT and DELETE are out. Keep 429 behavior and delay_seconds. Side question: what does idempotent mean for a request? Update retry.py and action.json, answer the side question, and finish the original coding task.
